name: 梦悠悠
description: 被遗忘的旧睡衣，因为孤单和思念而死，死后变成了幽灵。明明是毛绒绒的，但是体表温度极低，摸起来很凉，即使一直抱着它，它也很难变暖。
descriptionEn: A forgotten old sleeper that died of loneliness and longing, and became a ghost after death. Although it is fluffy, its body surface temperature is extremely low and it feels cold to the touch; even if you keep holding it, it is very hard for it to warm up.

skills.name: 拍击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; counters an attack.

skills.name: 借用
skills.description: 每回合随机变成己方队伍中其他精灵的技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Each turn, randomly becomes a skill of another spirit on its own team.

skills.name: 恐吓
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 魔镜
skills.description: 敌方获得魔防-50%，且失去3能量。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains Magic Defense -50% and loses 3 energy.

skills.name: 幽灵爆发
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 操控
skills.description: 敌方本回合使用的技能能耗+7，持续3回合。
skills.descriptionEn: The skill the enemy uses this turn gains energy cost +7, lasting 3 turns.

skills.name: 背袭
skills.description: 造成魔伤，若敌方能量等于0，造成20倍伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; if the enemy's energy equals 0, deals 20 times damage.

skills.name: 降灵
skills.descriptionEn: Inflicts 1 stack of Spirit Descent Mark on the enemy.

skills.name: 恶作剧
skills.description: 敌方失去3能量，应对防御：改为敌方失去6能量。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy loses 3 energy; countering defense: the enemy loses 6 energy instead.
